'''Nyyv''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] native to the oceanic [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. He owned and operated [[Uncle Nyyv's Floating Eatery]], found on [[Streysel Island]], during the height of the New Order. He was a native speaker of many languages, including [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]].

Translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]], the name "Nyyv" means "flexible"<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>.
